description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator module, specifically testing the resolution of runtime executables and parsing of version strings. It defines test functions that create temporary executable scripts, invoke the resolution logic, and verify expected outcomes, including success, failure, and error messages.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with a specified script content, sets executable permissions, and returns the file URL.

methods.name: `resolve succeeds with valid node`
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve successfully identifies a runtime when the version is above the minimum supported.

methods.name: `resolve fails on boundary below minimum`
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve returns an unsupported error when the version is below the required minimum.

methods.name: `resolve fails when too old`
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve returns an unsupported error when the version is too old.

methods.name: `resolve fails when version unparsable`
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve returns a version parse error when the version string cannot be parsed.

methods.name: `describe failure includes paths`
methods.description: Verifies that the error message for failure cases includes the searched paths and relevant version info.

methods.name: `runtime version parses with leading V and metadata`
methods.description: Tests the parsing of version strings with a leading 'v' or additional metadata to ensure correct extraction of version numbers.
